meta.name: Home Shanti
meta.description: The Joshi family slowly find out that there’s nothing shanti (peaceful) about building your dream home.

videos.title: Joshis ka Bhoomi Pujan
videos.overview: While Sarla eagerly looks forward to the bhoomi pujan, thanks to her thorough planning, her husband and children have other priorities. What are they up to?

videos.title: Ghar ka Naksha
videos.overview: The floor planning of the new house hits a roadblock when Sarla and Umesh demand a study, Naman a private gym and Jigyasa a separate bathroom. Not everyone can have their way.

videos.title: Deewaron ki Tarai
videos.overview: Sarla decides to not trust Pappu Pathak blindly, and Umesh discovers something unpleasant about him. Meanwhile, Jigyasa struggles to keep a secret from nosy Naman.

videos.title: Ghar ka Lanter
videos.overview: A corrupt official halts the roofing process, demanding a permit. As Umesh tries to remember the locker password to get the permit, Sarla struggles to get a new one.

videos.title: Budget ke Bahar Wale Interiors
videos.overview: When Sarla gets a quote from the interior designer, she gets a shock. While Umesh and Jigyasa head to a kavi sammelan, Sarla and Naman invade the flea market.

videos.title: Happy Annisary
videos.overview: Umesh plans a surprise marriage anniversary party for Sarla, but he is in for a bigger unpleasant surprise: Sarla has forgotten about their anniversary.
